# Sauel Almonte — Full-Stack & AI Engineer

## Who I Am

Sauel Almonte is a Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Boston, MA. He specializes in
building scalable cloud applications, AI-powered workflow automation, and modern web
experiences. He is bilingual (English and Spanish) and Dominican-American.

## Professional Experience

- Software Engineer at Wayfair — enterprise-level e-commerce engineering
- Software Engineer at North Light AI — AI workflow automation and startup engineering
- 4+ years of software engineering experience across 3 companies
- Mentor to 50+ early-career engineers through the Urban League of Eastern Massachusetts

## Technical Skills

### Full-Stack Web Development
Next.js, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, TailwindCSS, GSAP, Framer Motion,
ShadCN UI, REST APIs, GraphQL

### Backend & AI Engineering
Node.js, Python, Express, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Mongoose, Prisma, Resend, OpenAI APIs,
AI workflow automation, LLM integration

### Cloud & DevOps
Amazon Web Services (AWS), Docker, CI/CD, Vercel, serverless architecture,
cloud-native application development

## About This Site

This portfolio was built with Next.js 16 (App Router), TypeScript, TailwindCSS v4,
GSAP ScrollTrigger animations, MongoDB, and Auth.js. It includes a protected admin
dashboard for managing projects, skills, resume data, and subscribers.
